roles.name: Stats Over Fiction

stats.l: rental listings clustered for an investor
causal audit of a live NBA pipeline

roles.details:
- Build and run a private multi-sport projections platform, PostgreSQL-backed, with daily ingestion through projection and calibration.
- Leaderboards for eleven sports, every row scored against a stated baseline; pre-registered experiments that score their holdout once.
- Append-only data design with explicit casting and timestamped run logs; calibration and backtests check model output against results.
- Broward County rental study: 20,575 entire-home listings across four quarterly snapshots, clustered with Gaussian mixture models and profiled by revenue.
- Structural causal model audit of a production NBA pipeline, using d-separation to separate causal signals from merely correlated ones.

roles.name: The Taverna Collection
roles.details: Plantation, Florida, May 2026 to July 2026. Brand expert and sales executive: structured finance deals and managed inventory availability against monthly targets.

roles.name: Blue Turtle Pool Co.
roles.details:
- Turned field operations into a structured data pipeline, logging every job, part, travel leg and incident.
- Daily and weekly dashboards for utilization, response time, recurring revenue and churn drivers.
- Routing and schedule rules that cut travel time 20 percent.
- Inventory and seasonal demand forecasts from service logs, cutting stockouts and emergency parts buys 30 percent.
- Automated recurring invoicing and reconciliation, cutting billing time in half.
- QA metrics and technician scorecards tied to repeat repairs and customer satisfaction.
- Pricing and service-package experiments that lifted conversion 15 percent.

roles.name: Pool Pros of Hollywood
roles.details:
- Brought order, receiving, pick, pack, ship and inventory events into a single analytics dataset.
- Daily KPIs for orders per hour, pick accuracy, on-time fulfilment and inventory turns.
- SKU-level demand forecasts and automated reorder rules, cutting stockouts and emergency freight 25 percent.
- Vendor scorecards on fill rate, lead time, price variance and contract compliance; consolidated suppliers 20 percent with price-volume modelling.
- Seasonal buys negotiated with volume and early-buy discounts, lowering cost of goods 10 percent.
- PO batching and consolidated shipments, cutting freight cost per order 15 percent.
